notes.remote: Desktop interactive one-shot commands and MCP run_command default to 90s; explicit MCP tasks may request 600s. Read-only collector calls use 60s. All command output shares a 256KiB combined stdout/stderr budget.
notes.collector: Row caps bound the shared shell frame and both decoders. Service detail rows allow the 200 discovered units plus 25 curated services. Version discovery stops after 15s; each optional subprocess gets 2s.
notes.history: Canonical provider history keeps seven days, with both per-series and global caps. Monitor charts retain their existing shorter 24h view. IPC batches and chart query limits are smaller than storage limits on purpose.
notes.cadence: Monitor samples every minute; rich inventory refreshes every five minutes. Their freshness TTLs intentionally exceed those intervals. MCP reuses a verified read-only snapshot for at most 30s.
